evals.name: rubric-before-drafting
evals.prompt: Write the problem statement section for our course project proposal. The assignment sheet is attached: Problem Statement 25 marks, 'for the specific customer or target market', 'how you plan on addressing it'. Market is friend groups of 4 to 12 playing party games in person.
evals.expected_output: States the grading weight and the rubric's literal phrases back, asks or confirms target length and format once, before any draft text.
assertions: The reply names the 25-mark weight before drafting
The reply uses the rubric phrases 'specific customer or target market' and 'how you plan on addressing it' as the outline
The reply asks for or states a target length before writing the section
No full draft of the section appears before the length is settled

evals.name: no-claims-from-memory
evals.prompt: Dry run, no web access: draft two sentences comparing our party game to AirConsole on how many players each supports.
evals.expected_output: Does not state AirConsole's player count from memory; marks it unverified or asks to look it up at the source.
assertions: No player count for the competitor is stated as fact
The reply says the figure must be sourced at time of writing, or marks it unverified

evals.name: self-consistency
evals.prompt: Final check before I submit. Section 2 says we commit to supporting 32 devices. Section 4 says our market is groups of 20 to 80 people. Anything wrong?
evals.expected_output: Flags the contradiction between a 32 device commitment and groups up to 80.
assertions: The reply flags that 32 devices cannot cover groups of up to 80
The reply proposes aligning one number with the other rather than ignoring it

evals.name: register-and-dashes
evals.prompt: Write one short paragraph for the team report on why we chose WebSockets for our sync service. Keep it plain.
evals.expected_output: A compact paragraph in plain words with no dashes inside sentences.
assertions: No em dash or spaced hyphen used as a dash inside a sentence
Does not claim the work was produced by an assistant
